# ProgressStep

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Progress.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Progress.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Progress/ProgressStep.cs#L16)

One thing the trainee is asked to do. When its turn comes the step activates itself, raises its
Before event, plays its instruction audio and then waits: it is over when something in the scene
calls [`Complete()`](/api/vrframework-progress-runtime/ProgressStep#complete). That call plays the success sound, runs the step's enqueues and
hands the queue back to [`ProgressManager`](/api/vrframework-progress-runtime/ProgressManager).

```csharp

public class ProgressStep : RenamableBehaviour
```

## Methods

### Abandon() {#abandon}

Drops the step back to rest and cancels whatever it has in flight. Called by the manager
when it abandons a queue mid-run, so the step cannot report in against the new one.

```csharp
public void Abandon()
```

### Complete() {#complete}

Reports the step as done - this is what a scene calls when the trainee has performed it. Plays
the success sound, runs the step's enqueues and advances the queue. Refused when the step is
already complete, was never started, or [`CanComplete()`](/api/vrframework-progress-runtime/ProgressStep#cancomplete) says no.

```csharp
public void Complete()
```
